_comment: Friendly names for Shelly devices and channels, used by dashboard.py.
This file exists because the Shelly APP stores the name you set in SHELLY
CLOUD, not on the device: sys.device.name reads null over the LAN, so a
local-only dashboard cannot see it. Naming a device in its OWN web UI
(http://<ip> -> Settings) does write it down, and the dashboard prefers
that when present -- this file is the override and the fallback.
It is also the only way to label a multi-channel device. A Pro 3EM has
three CT clamps on three unrelated circuits and one device name, so the
channels have to be named somewhere.
A string names the whole device. An object names channels by their id,
as reported by the device: 'switch:0' on a Gen2 plug, 'relay:0' and
'relay:1' on a Gen1 two-relay device, 'em1:0'..'em1:2' on a Pro 3EM.
Copy to .shelly-labels.json and edit. That file is gitignored: which
circuits are in your house is nobody else's business.
